description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'JobTitleSearchFilterParams' used for filtering search parameters related to job titles in the HRM system. It extends a base DTO class and includes properties and methods for sorting and filtering options.

classes.name: JobTitleSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used to encapsulate filtering parameters for job title searches, including sorting and active-only filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with a default sort field 'jt.jobTitleName'.

methods.name: getActiveOnly
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'activeOnly' filter, indicating whether to filter only active job titles.

methods.name: setActiveOnly
methods.description: Sets the 'activeOnly' filter parameter; accepts a boolean or null.
